info.name: PowerSchool SIS REST Authentication Students API

params.name: pagesize
params.description: Number of records to return per page.

params.name: q
params.description: Filter expression using FIQL-like syntax. Example: id=ge=10000 to filter records with id >= 10000.

params.name: projection
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. Omit to return all fields.

items.docs: Returns all students enrolled in the current district. Supports pagination via pagesize and page query parameters, and filtering via the q parameter (e.g., q=id=ge=10000).
Returns the total count of students enrolled in the current district.

params.name: studentDcid
params.description: The student's DCID (not student ID or student number)

params.name: projection
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. Omit to return all fields.

items.docs: Returns a single student record by their DCID (district-level unique identifier).
